answer: The ivory assignment is published and lantern records each panel. Shards are assigned from the beacon graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1454 identities would post 4856 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
